generatedFrom.included: original labels (no round field) and rounds "r6-unseen", "r7-unseen", "r8-unseen", "r9-unseen"; finding-level labels only; scored and review-routed (demoted) locations alike

excluded.gateRounds: round matching /gate/ (r5-gate, r6-gate, r7-gate): labels added on already-tuned code
excluded.labelAuditRounds: round matching /label-audit/: rows re-judged in place after first sight (counted by the round-6 measurement, excluded from round 8 on)
excluded.hRepos: h-* label files carry round-3 judgements (tool output v4) made after the round-2 holdout was tuned on; they are not first-sight. Reported separately under hReposRound3 for comparison only.

generatedFrom.wilson: Wilson score interval, two-sided 90% (z=1.645), lower bound on tp/(tp+fp); UNCERTAIN excluded from precision
generatedFrom.subSignalKeys: stable keys <RULE>:<signal>; emittedBy names the emitting file:function/branch, howToDetect says what the engine knows at emit time
generatedFrom.byRound: per sub-signal tp/fp/unc/precision/lower90 by round group (repo prefix: n, r4, r5, r6, r7)
generatedFrom.fpRepos: per sub-signal, the number of repos its FP labels come from (demotion needs at least 2, calibrate.js DEMOTE_MIN_FP_REPOS)
generatedFrom.atReview: per sub-signal, the subset of its labels whose location was shown in review[] when it was labelled (reviewVerdict present; r7 on). Already counted in tp/fp/unc
